decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the newly specified complete lesson/story types and standalone-comprehension requirement; the prior state already required full, educational moments.
The source selection criterion concerns completeness and teaching value, not visual editing style or effects; separate clauses in the message already govern this candidate.
Requiring complete, valuable lessons or stories does not change the independently retained effective-hook requirement.
The source selection change does not alter caption color, font, or effects; those are addressed by separate clauses and an existing same-message Event.
The batch count, acceptance condition, and redo obligation remain unchanged by the moment-selection criterion; the same message already records the required redo work.
This candidate describes the earlier initial trial, which had already been completed and accepted; the requalification selection rule does not retroactively change it.
The complete-moment selection criterion applies to the requalification clips and does not change the completed extended-trial batch's count, source, or recorded acceptance standard.
Moment completeness and teaching value do not modify the independent 30-to-90-second duration limits.
